SPIRITS-STONE_REMNANTS.title: Stone Remnants
SPIRITS-STONE_REMNANTS.description: Consumed to trigger enhanced [ ] effects. Max 7.
SPIRITS-FLASH.title: Flash
SPIRITS-FLASH.description: When Flash reaches 3: gain 1 Intangible, reduce Flash by 3, and end your turn.
SPIRITS-STATIC_REMNANTS.title: Static Remnants
SPIRITS-STATIC_REMNANTS.description: At the start of your next turn, deal damage to all enemies equal to this value (unaffected by Strength or Dexterity), then reset to 0.
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT.title: Fire Remnant
SPIRITS-FIRE_REMNANT.description: Consumed by Activate Fire Remnant to gain Flash equal to the stack count.
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD.title: Overload
SPIRITS-OVERLOAD.description: After playing a Skill, gain 1 Overload. Overload cap equals your current Overload stacks.
SPIRITS-OVERLOADED.title: Overloaded
SPIRITS-OVERLOADED.description: When you play an Attack, gain 4 Static Remnants and spend 1 Overloaded.
SPIRITS-ETHEREALIZE.title: Etherealize
SPIRITS-ETHEREALIZE.description: Cards with Etherealize cannot be played while in the Etherealized state. Nonlocality removes this state.
SPIRITS-VOID.title: Void
SPIRITS-VOID.description: Sent to the Consumed pile after being played.
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE.title: Real Phase
SPIRITS-REAL_PHASE.description: When Static Remnants trigger and Real Phase > 0, consume 1 Real Phase and resolve the trigger damage again.
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE.title: Imaginary Phase
SPIRITS-IMAGINARY_PHASE.description: When Static Remnants trigger and Imaginary Phase > 0, consume 1 Imaginary Phase instead; Static Remnants are not consumed this trigger.
